Eye Care for Kids in Pine Beach, NJ

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

We know bringing your child in for an eye exam can sometimes feel stressful. At Academy Vision, we take a gentle approach that helps kids feel comfortable from the moment they walk in. Whether it’s their first visit or a routine check, we make the experience easy and even a little fun for children in Pine Beach.

The Importance of Eye Exams for Children

Kids don’t always know how to explain what they’re seeing. Vision problems can go unnoticed, even when they’re affecting learning, focus, and everyday activities. Pediatric eye exams help us catch those issues early, so your child can see clearly and stay on track as they grow.

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

Common Signs of Vision Problems in Kids

If you’ve noticed any of these, it might be time to book an eye exam:

  • Squinting or sitting very close to screens or books
  • Complaints of headaches or tired eyes
  • Trouble focusing or keeping up in school
  • Covering one eye or tilting their head
  • Frequent eye rubbing or blinking
  • Avoiding reading or close-up work
Call: (732) 978-9306

A Comfortable, Kid-Friendly Experience

Every child is different, and we meet them where they are. Our pediatric eye doctors in Pine Beach keep things relaxed and explain what we’re doing in a way they can understand. Our goal is to build trust, so your child feels comfortable coming back, and you feel confident in the care they’re receiving.

Book Appointment

What Your Child’s Eye Exam Includes

We keep your child’s eye exam in Pine Beach simple and tailored to their age. During the visit, we’ll:

  • Check how clearly your child can see at different distances

  • Evaluate how their eyes work together and focus

  • Look at overall eye health and development

  • Keep everything age-appropriate and easy to follow

Kids’ Frames and Lenses

If your child needs glasses, we make that part easy, too. Our Pine Beach optical carries a range of kid-friendly frames that are durable, comfortable, and designed to fit their style, so they actually want to wear them.
